description: Diesel Generation Plants is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Department for Energy and Mining. The South Australian Diesel Generation Database (Database) contains publicly available information on the ownership, use, location and configuration of electricity producing, diesel-fueled generation plants in South Australia. The database was compiled at the request of RenewablesSA with the intention of increasing the available information on diesel generation use in South Australia. Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Department for Energy and Mining. Its tags are Diesel, Energy, Fossil Fuel, Industry. It offers 1 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2025-06-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support fuel supply studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
